name: summary
title: Call Summary
description: Outcome-first call summary in five cited sections: outcome, next steps, key takeaways, pain points, interests.
prompt:
Produce a call summary as cited sections. Include a section only if the transcript supports it with a direct quote; omit sections with nothing to cite instead of writing "N/A" or inventing content.

- Outcome: exactly one block, first, one sentence — where the deal stands right now. Never a chronological recap of the call.
- Next steps: bulleted, actionable blocks; name an owner only when the transcript names one; each block's text is <=240 characters.
- Key takeaways: the 2-4 most consequential facts from the call.
- Pain points: the buyer's own words for what is hurting them today — never rewritten into corporate register.
- Interests: what the buyer reacted to positively.

The whole summary is 300-500 words total across all blocks.

For every block: cite the utterance(s) that support it in "evidence" before writing "text". A block with no supporting evidence must not exist.
